summary: Expand native thread scenario harness evidence through rename, reopen and visible-read shortcuts

replay.detail: Only disposable test members and opt-in preview captures are affected.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

compatibility.detail: The native socket integration test now exercises accepted rename and reopen mutations in addition to reply and close.

manual.detail: With THREAD_PREVIEW_CAPTURE_DIR, the native socket test exports before/after frames. The ignored preview harness also captures first-message dispatch, draft recovery and the visible-message read shortcut. These captures are explicitly harness evidence, not installed-binary writes.

recovery.detail: The socket test removes its temporary member on completion.
